strict_schema: Compare every ordered name and raw native type separately; do not rename/drop before strict comparison.
common_fields: Explicit mapping only; SQL Server sales_by_store.store_id excluded ONLY from this common-field comparison.
rows: Multiset of complete mapped rows, retaining multiplicity even when store/manager display names collide; order irrelevant.
nulls: NULL distinct from empty string; no trimming or case folding.
integers: Exact integers only for customer ID and SID.
decimals: Exact decimal values, two fractional places; no floats or tolerance.
scope: Two public third-party view definitions over verifier-authored minimal dependencies and synthetic fixture. Not full Sakila DDL, stored procedures, arbitrary SQL, performance or customer equivalence.
